newsitem.title: USA: Edison marketing unit opens Portland office.
newsitem.headline: Edison marketing unit opens Portland office.

text.p: Edison Source, the unregulated power marketing subsidiary of Edison International, announced Thursday the opening of a regional energy marketing office in Portland, Ore.

"The opening of our Oregon office is just the beginning of our national expansion efforts," said C. Alex Miller, president of Edison Source. "Having a strong local presence in the Pacific Northwest has strategic importance, as it will enable us to be closer to our wholesale customers."
Edison International's main subsidiary is Southern California Edison Co.
